description: This file contains functions related to Ubiquiti Networks' EdgeRouter X (ubnt erx) device upgrade process, including kernel management and partition handling.

methods.name: ubnt_get_target_kernel
methods.description: Determines the target kernel partition ('kernel1' or 'kernel2') based on the current kernel index offset in the factory partition.

methods.name: ubnt_update_target_kernel
methods.description: Updates the kernel boot index in the factory partition to switch the active kernel.

methods.name: platform_upgrade_ubnt_erx
methods.description: Main upgrade routine that manages the kernel partition, clears legacy volume, and performs the upgrade on the device.
